infile.scope: Open the required MeasurementSet with complex DATA or float total-power input.

calmode.scope: Generate position-switch and spectral Tsys tables and support direct application and their composite application modes.

fraction.scope: Match numeric and percent forms and validation in position-switch mode.

noff.scope: Use the explicit edge count when checking the fraction bound in position-switch mode.

applytable.scope: Read a path or path list with sky, spectral Tsys and Jy/K calibration and apply the terms in CASA calibration order.

interp.scope: Interpolate reference spectra in time and frequency with distinct signal and exposure-weight laws.

spwmap.scope: Map science windows to Tsys windows using a flat list or ordered source-to-target dictionary.

outfile.scope: Publish standard CASA-readable generation products. Applications update CORRECTED_DATA in the input MeasurementSet.

overwrite.scope: Replace a generated table with explicit consent while protecting locked outputs and MeasurementSet subtables.

field.scope: Apply field selection to position-switch reference rows and validate it for Tsys.

spw.scope: Select position-switch windows and require the all-window form for Tsys.

scan.scope: Select position-switch scans and require the all-scan form for Tsys.

behaviors.title: Position-switch sky spectra
behaviors.scope: Group OFF integrations by observing metadata, average each unflagged cell by exposure, and publish CASA-compatible times, flags, weights and solution shape.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: System-temperature calibration
behaviors.scope: Generate spectral Tsys tables through the shared calibration path, including observing scan assignment and canonical calibration subtables.
behaviors.gap: Dataset-scale performance validation follows functionality under #979.

behaviors.title: Sky calibration application
behaviors.scope: Apply sky, spectral Tsys and Jy/K tables from native and CASA writers to complex or float autocorrelation data, including PS/Tsys composites, exposure-based weights and ordered SPW maps.
behaviors.gap: OTF and raster composite generation and application are tracked in #1530.

behaviors.title: OTF and raster sky calibration
behaviors.scope: Select off-source scan edges for OTF and gapped raster observations.

decisions.inputs: A sky calibration table with a clear flag and a zero OFF reference spectrum.
decisions.casa: Divides by the zero spectrum and leaves the channel unflagged.
decisions.ours: Retains the value entering the sky correction and flags the invalid sample in flag-writing modes.
decisions.rationale: The OFF spectrum is the denominator of the correction and cannot define a finite calibrated value at zero.
decisions.impact: Adjacent channels with valid references still calibrate and downstream consumers can mask the invalid correction.

generation.kind: Same-input CASA and native calibration tables
generation.scope: Public position-switch and Tsys generation with float and complex data, unequal exposures, channel and scan selection, single-polarization padding and publication protections.
generation.result: Native and CASA tables agreed in the paired cases, including unused SPW flags and moving-field Tsys metadata.

remaining.scope: OTF and raster sky and composite calibration, observing geometry, and paired edge selection.

application.kind: Paired public-Python CASA/native application plus 2x2 calibration-table interchange
application.scope: Direct and PS/Tsys composite application, DATA and FLOAT_DATA, mapped Tsys and Jy/K, exposure weighting and nonlinear frequency resampling.
application.result: Corrected visibilities, flags, scalar and spectral weights and float scratch units agree across both writers and readers. Irregular exposure and a distinct Tsys window give independent physical expectations. The zero-reference decision has its own executable comparison.
